jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Operations (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
JOIN OUR TEAM

As a Senior Product Manager, you will join our Technology team to drive the efficiency of Westwing's supply chain and fulfilment operations across Europe. Operating at the intersection of business and technology, you will partner with senior stakeholders to translate operational strategy into scalable systems across warehouse, order, and delivery management. Having recently completed a major migration of our order and warehouse management systems to modern SaaS platforms, we are now transitioning from initial stabilisation to building the next generation of scalable capabilities on top of that foundation. In this high-impact role, you will directly drive operational excellence and cost efficiency by shaping the systems that power our end-to-end processes, from initial sourcing to final customer delivery. This position is permanent and based in Munich.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Partner with stakeholders across Sourcing, Logistics, Warehouse, and Operations to own the roadmap for our Supply Chain and Fulfilment systems, spanning both SaaS platforms and in-house tools
  • Own and drive measurable business outcomes aligned with company OKRs and operational performance targets, translating operational needs into clear functional specifications and defining KPIs for data-led optimisation
  • Coordinate the implementation of new and existing capabilities with our SaaS vendors and integration partners, driving delivery through to rollout
  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for in-house operational tools, from prioritisation and delivery to continuous improvement, working closely with engineering, data, and design teams to ensure high-quality, scalable, and timely delivery
  • Drive product discovery to identify automation and optimisation opportunities, leveraging AI and emerging technologies to innovate across the supply chain
  • Make build-versus-buy decisions based on speed, scalability, and long-term impact, helping shape our evolving strategy across SaaS and in-house tooling as AI lowers the cost of custom software


YOU COME WITH

  • 5+ years of product management experience within e-commerce, retail, or logistics, with a solid understanding of fulfilment and warehouse operations and systems such as OMS, WMS, or ERP
  • Proven track record of implementing, configuring, and integrating SaaS solutions, with a strong comfort level blending product ownership with hands-on vendor and implementation coordination
  • Extensive experience in project management, business analysis, Agile methodologies, and leading cross-functional teams to drive continuous process improvements
  • Comfort with Excel and SQL, combined with practical experience using AI tools to accelerate research, documentation, and prototyping
  • Strong analytical mindset with a passion for using data to distinguish between what technically works and what truly scales
  • Fluency in English paired with excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders across all functional and management levels
  • High resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities


WHY WESTWING

If you are looking for a place where ambition meets creativity, where ideas turn into impact fast, and where people are trusted to grow - you have found it.
At Westwing, we’re building the Superbrand in Design with a team that’s shaping the future of beautiful home & living.

Here is what you can look forward to:

• A high-performance culture built on trust, feedback and collaboration
• An inspiring, international environment that empowers you to think big, take ownership, and grow beyond your comfort zone
• A flexible hybrid setup with 3 office days per week - because strong connections and quick collaboration make great ideas happen
• Work-from-anywhere opportunities for up to 4 weeks per year - as fresh perspectives spark bold ideas
• 30 days of paid holiday to rest, recharge, and come back ready to create
• A beautiful, centrally located, dog-friendly office with inspiring spaces, a sunny terrace, and good food - designed for moments that energise and connect
• Exclusive discounts - 40% off Westwing Collection, 20% off third-party brands (each on non-reduced items), 10% Family & Friends discount, plus special-occasion vouchers
• Wellbeing support through mental health resources, sports memberships, and preventive care
• Sustainable mobility options with discounted public transport and JobRad - moving with purpose and care for the planet
• Support for working parents, including our on-site Westwing Wichtel daycare and a partnership with multilingual provider Elly & Stoffl
• One annual Social Impact Day to give back to a cause you care about - because being human is our true superpower
• Team rituals that celebrate results and togetherness - from Summer & Winter Parties to Oktoberfest


ABOUT US

Westwing, Europe’s #1 in Beautiful Living e-commerce, is present in 20+ European countries and achieved a GMV (Gross Merchandise Volume) of EUR 507 million in 2025. As Europe’s premium one-stop destination for Design Lovers, it offers a unique brand experience with a carefully curated assortment of the Westwing Collection and 3rd party design brands. The integrated platform combines Shop, Daily Specials, Stores, the B2B Service (Westwing Business) and the Westwing Design Service. Westwing’s team works together on its shared purpose to “Excite people to create homes that unlock the full beauty of life”. Founded in 2011, Westwing is headquartered in Munich and went public on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in October 2018.

Our team is a diverse group of professionals aiming for high performance, working together at a fast pace in an inspiring, international and informal environment that enables you to grow your career while working with a brand and products our customers love. We’re made up of passionate people who are creative enough to disrupt the status quo, brave enough to fail and smart enough to win. So come, be part of the “wow, you work at Westwing?” crowd.

Diversity is deeply rooted in our culture. Our mission doesn’t stop to inspire only your design choices, it continues to embrace an inclusive lifestyle filled with respect to everyone’s uniqueness, cultural differences and equal opportunity.


Department

Technology

jobs.title: Product Manager: Customer Onboarding Experience
jobs.description:
About You

You are a technically fluent, customer-obsessed PM who gets energized by removing friction from developer workflows. You have a strong instinct for what makes integrations feel fast and safe, and you know how to balance developer needs with long-term product maintainability. You bring systems thinking to SDK and tracking decisions, hold a high bar for integration correctness and reliability, and are energized by the challenge of reducing time-to-value for the teams and customers who depend on you.


About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

About the Position

As the PM for Customer Developer Experience + Customer Data Integrations, you will own the end-to-end integration journey for Constructor's customers and SIs — from first setup through long-term adoption. Your north star is time-to-value: making it fast, correct, and reliable for any team to integrate with Constructor and start getting results.

You will span two tightly connected surfaces:

  • CDX — SDKs, UI libraries, integration patterns, docs, and the extensibility model that lets customers build on Constructor without accumulating hidden complexity.

  • CDI — tracking/instrumentation, data attributes, event validation tooling, and the reliability + correctness of the data flows that power Constructor's AI.

Day-to-day, you will:

  • Define and drive a roadmap that measurably reduces integration time, defects, and escalations.

  • Improve integration correctness for key tracking flows (search → PDP → conversion, sponsored click tracking, etc.) by reducing common failure modes and adding robust validation and diagnostics.

  • Build and evolve validation and debugging tooling that empowers customers, Solutions Engineers, and Customer Success to self-serve faster.

  • Define clear support and capability boundaries to reduce high-visibility escalations and improve customer predictability.

  • Partner with Engineering, Solutions/CS, and other Product teams to sequence work, de-risk launches, and ensure new capabilities ship integration-ready.

Define and report a CDX+CDI KPI stack (time-to-first-value, adoption, defect rate, escalation volume, doc findability) and drive continuous improvement.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of product management experience shipping developer-facing or integration-heavy products — such as SDKs, APIs, web tracking/instrumentation, data pipelines, or developer tooling.

  • Demonstrated ability to reduce time-to-value or integration complexity in a B2B SaaS environment — with concrete, measurable outcomes.

  • Technical fluency sufficient to reason credibly about event flows, browser/web constraints, attribution, versioning, breaking changes, and rollout risk — without needing to be an engineer.

  • Track record of strong cross-functional collaboration: aligning Engineering, Customer Success, Solutions, and other Product teams on priorities and support boundaries.

  • Comfort defining metrics and making decisions with imperfect data; experience building and reporting product health dashboards.

  • Strong written communication — clear specs, integration guides, capability docs, and stakeholder updates.

Benefits

🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year

💰 A competitive compensation package including stock options

🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees

🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

🏥 Company sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee)

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor

At we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übersetzt Strategie in Features: Du identifizierst Nutzerprobleme, bewertest Markt- und Wettbewerbstrends und entwickelst aus groben Zielen und Produktvisionen konkrete Features – mit einem Gespür dafür, was besonders mobile Produkte auszeichnet.

  • Du schreibst Anforderungen, die tragen: Du bereitest Themen so auf, dass Designer und Entwickler direkt loslegen können – nicht erst nachfragen müssen.

  • Du denkst User Journeys, nicht nur User Stories: Du skizzierst Konzepte, verwirfst Ideen, entwickelst sie weiter – und findest den besten Weg für unsere Nutzer:innen.

  • Du coachst und befähigst: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Product Managern zusammen, gibst fachliches Feedback und hilfst ihnen, in ihrer Rolle zu wachsen.

  • Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle: Im engen Austausch mit Projektleitung, UX, Entwicklung, Sales und weiteren Stakeholdern sorgst du dafür, dass aus Ideen echte Features werden – termingerecht und in hoher Qualität.

  • Du machst Erfolg messbar: Gemeinsam mit den Teams definierst du Erfolgskennzahlen, leitest daraus Prioritäten ab und misst den Erfolg neuer Produktinitiativen.


Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement – idealerweise mit digitalen Produkten, die eine hohe Komplexität und Reichweite haben, und bringst Erfahrung in der Weiterentwicklung digitaler Produkte mit.

  • Du hast Strategie in Features übersetzt – nicht nur verwaltet, sondern aktiv gestaltet. Du kannst zeigen, welche Produkte du konzeptionell vorangebracht und von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung begleitet hast.

  • Du verstehst, was mobile Produkte anders macht als Web – du musst kein App-Store-Experte sein, aber du kennst die Unterschiede in UX, Architektur und Nutzerverhalten.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us

We are champions of rail, inspired to build a greener, more sustainable future of travel. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

Now Europe’s number 1 downloaded rail app, with over 135 million monthly visits and £6.3 billion in annual ticket sales, we collaborate with 270+ rail and coach companies in over 40 countries. We want to create a world where travel is as simple, seamless, eco-friendly and affordable as it should be. 

Today, we're a FTSE 250 company driven by our incredible team of over 1,000 Trainliners from 50+ nationalities, based across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. With our focus on growth in the UK and Europe, now is the perfect time to join us on this high-speed journey. 

Introducing the Trainline International Supply Team 👋
Trainline exists to make rail and coach travel easier for millions of customers across Europe - and the International Supply team is at the heart of making that possible. We work at the intersection of commercial partnerships, technical integrations, and customer experience, bringing new carriers and markets to life on the Trainline platform. The work we do shapes how customers across the continent discover, book, and travel - and there is plenty more to build.

As a Senior Product Manager in this team, you will own the end-to-end journey of bringing new markets onto the platform - from understanding the underlying customer problem through to how a new carrier or market shows up in the experience. You will work across two squads, going deep where it matters most, and collaborating closely with Engineering, Design, Commercial, Legal, Finance, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver real impact at scale.


In this role as the Senior Product Manager, International Supply, you will... 🚄

  • Lead the discovery, scoping, and delivery of new market launches, owning the product strategy from initial problem framing through to customer-facing experience

  • Develop a deep understanding of how new carriers and markets are integrated into the Trainline platform, and ensure that complexity is invisible to the customer

  • Make informed investment decisions across the supply portfolio - balancing where to deepen existing integrations, where to improve what is already live, and where to prioritise launching net new markets or carriers

  • Work across two squads, managing priorities effectively across both while going deep on the areas of highest impact

  • Define and track the metrics that matter, building a clear point of view on what success looks like and why - and using data to drive decisions at every stage

  • Collaborate closely with Commercial colleagues to understand the economics of different markets, including commission structures and partner dynamics, ensuring product decisions are commercially grounded

  • Work across the full product stack, partnering with Engineering to understand technical constraints and opportunities, particularly around API integrations with carrier and market partners

  • Embed AI tools and approaches into your ways of working to accelerate the speed at which value reaches our customers

  • Partner with Legal, Finance, GTM, and Marketing teams to ensure new market launches are set up for success from day one

We'd love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager working across multiple European markets, with a strong track record of launching or scaling products in a multi-market environment

  • The ability to understand the customer problem end to end - from how a market or carrier is integrated technically through to how that experience lands for the customer

  • Experience managing a portfolio of integrations or partnerships, with the judgement to assess where further investment will drive the most value versus where net new opportunities should be prioritised

  • A strong metrics mindset, with the ability to identify the right things to measure, articulate why they matter, and use insight to guide prioritisation and trade-offs

  • Solid understanding of APIs and how technical integrations work at a high level, with the confidence to engage meaningfully with Engineering teams on integration complexity

  • Experience working across multiple squads or workstreams simultaneously, with the organisational clarity to manage competing priorities without losing depth

  • Strong commercial awareness, including familiarity with commission structures, partner economics, and the ability to collaborate effectively with Commercial stakeholders

  • Confidence using AI tools to improve the speed and quality of your work, and a curiosity to keep developing in this area as the tooling evolves

  • Experience in or knowledge of the ground transport or travel industry is a plus, and will help you hit the ground running in this role

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor!

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Onboarding (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Why we need you

Maltego is a tool used globally by industry experts, analysts, and law enforcement agencies to help protect and watch over their own infrastructure but also to keep guard on internet safety, reduce crime and catch bad guys.
 
The Program Manager, Onboarding owns both delivery and governance within Maltego's customer onboarding program. You manage a portfolio of complex accounts from Sales handover to Customer Success handover, and simultaneously govern the playbooks, SOPs, and continuous improvement initiatives that allow the full onboarding team to deliver quality at scale. This role combines hands-on customer engagement with program-level leadership — you run accounts, and you design the systems others work within.


What to expect

Onboarding Delivery

  • Manage a portfolio of complex, high-touch, and scale-touch accounts end-to-end, balancing delivery responsibilities with program governance work.
  • Design and execute onboarding plans for accounts with advanced technical or organizational requirements.
  • Deliver Customer Success handovers that consistently meet or exceed acceptance criteria, maintaining high CSAT across your portfolio.
  • Use insights from account work to identify patterns and inform program improvement.
Program Management
  • Design the playbooks and SOPs for Scale-touch and High-touch onboarding, maintaining accuracy and ensuring they reflect current best practice.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives: identifying inefficiencies, designing solutions, and driving rollout across the team.
  • Coordinate with Scaled and Digital Onboarding Managers to ensure program consistency across all onboarding formats.
  • Manage content accuracy as a program responsibility, working with Product to keep onboarding resources current after releases.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Build credibility with stakeholders through consistent delivery and clear communication.
  • Represent the program perspective in cross-functional meetings, contributing structured analysis and concrete recommendations.
  • Surface patterns from onboarding delivery into cross-team discussions, ensuring program feedback reaches the right people.
Customer Engagement
  • Serve as the primary customer contact for assigned accounts throughout the onboarding engagement.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Facilitate complex discovery conversations that surface strategic use cases and inform onboarding design.
  • Proactively address customer concerns before they become escalations.
Feedback, Reporting & Process Improvement
  • Synthesize feedback from accounts and program touchpoints into actionable recommendations for relevant teams.
  • Drive specific process improvement initiatives from identification through rollout, managing stakeholder alignment and change management.
  • Contribute to onboarding content and documentation improvements that scale across the full team.


Your profile in short

Required

  • Proven track record managing complex customer onboarding or implementation engagements in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
  • Demonstrated experience owning program governance — playbooks, SOPs, or process frameworks used by other team members.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to balance multiple concurrent engagements and program initiatives.
  • Excellent communication skills — able to calibrate messaging for customers, internal stakeholders, and senior leadership.

jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape how Pleo builds AI-powered product features, working alongside software engineers, data engineers and data scientists to take ideas from prototype to production. Pleo has over 40,000 customers and a decade of unique spend data — an incredible foundation to build on. Your mission will be to harness this data to create real product value.

Please note: applications will be open until 1st September 2026 at 09.00 CEST. We will not review any application before the window is closed so please take all the time you need to submit a great application!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You'll be reporting to the Senior Manager for Data & AI Products and will be one of the first hires in the team but, rest assured, you will not be working solo! You will work very closely with other Engineers and Data Scientists, each bringing distinctive skills while you bring applied AI engineering and data context. Together, the team covers the full chain from data to shipped product.

Your core focus is on building and shipping AI-powered features, with a strong collaborative element across Product Engineering, AI Platform, and Data & ML Platform teams.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer you will:

  • Build and ship AI-powered product features for Pleo’s customers, owning outcomes end-to-end for a scoped area.

  • Design and build end-to-end RAG systems for specific product use cases: chunking strategies, embedding model selection, retrieval optimisation, and quality evaluation.

  • Own the full AI-product lifecycle: prompt design, context and state management, agentic loops, output parsing, edge case handling, and safe production deployment.

  • Build evaluation datasets and automated eval pipelines that give the team confidence in AI feature quality before and after changes.

  • Instrument AI features for production observability: logging, drift detection, quality monitoring, and alerting.

  • Collaborate with Product and Design to scope AI features from first principles; you are a co-author of what gets built, not just an implementer of specs.

  • Partner with our GenAI Platform team to identify infrastructure needs and champion adoption of platform tooling.

  • Support other engineers through reviews, pairing, and pragmatic technical leadership on the projects you lead.

What you bring

You will thrive in this role if you have:

  • Proven experience shipping customer-facing AI features using LLMs; beyond prototype stage and into real production systems with real users.

  • Deep practical experience with RAG system design and the full retrieval pipeline: embedding models, vector databases, chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking.

  • Experience building and operating evaluation frameworks for LLM-based systems; you have a systematic approach to measuring quality.

  • Strong Python engineering; your code is production-grade, tested, and maintainable.

  • Experience building APIs and data retrieval pipelines that feed context into AI systems.

  • Enough data intuition to reason about data quality, schema, and retrieval architecture without needing a dedicated data engineer beside you at all times.

  • Experience with agentic system patterns: tool use, multi-step orchestration, error handling in LLM workflows.

  • Familiarity with public cloud providers (AWS, GCP)

  • We operate a polyglot platform, with components written in Kotlin and Python. While this role is Python-focused, you will need from time to time to contribute in a Kotlin stack, so being open to that is important.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You have strong product instincts and build with the user in mind. You understand that a model is only as good as the problem it solves.

  • You have moved past prototyping and have a deep understanding of the realities of LLMOps, data retrieval, prompt and context engineering, as well as model evaluation in production.

  • You don't just call APIs, you understand the data feeding the AI system and can reason about data quality, architecture, and retrieval without needing a dedicated data engineer beside you at all times.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You are primarily interested in model research or algorithm development. This role is about shipping working AI features to production.

  • You need fully defined specs and a groomed backlog to operate effectively. We expect you to discover and define the problem alongside Product and Design.

  • You cannot explain AI trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. You will regularly work with Product Managers, Designers, and business leaders who need to understand what is and isn't possible.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Familiarise yourself with our codebase, tooling and roadmap.

  • Partner with our Principal Engineer to define and own our approach to AI feature development.

  • Contribute to shaping the roadmap for tooling and features developed by our GenAI Core team.

  • Collaborate with Product and Data teams to ship a first feature to production

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills!

The location

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work.

We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Technical screening: A 15 to 30 minute call with our Talent Partner to check your knowledge of key technical topics

  3. System design interview: A 75-minute practical session with our engineers focusing on scoping and designing an AI feature

  4. Live coding interview: A 75-minute practical session with our engineers focusing on implementing your solution.

  5. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute conversation to deep dive into your knowledge and experience.

  6. Final interview: A leadership interview focusing on your behavioural, communication and collaboration skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: this is neither a research-driven nor a traditional data or software engineering role. We're looking for someone with proven experience shipping customer-facing AI products who can also confidently operate at Senior level in a SaaS organisation. This means we'll be looking for evidence that you can own fairly complex technical features from design to implementation.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

RSE+ Netzwerk Produktion – Das sind wir, ein dynamisches & erfahrenes Team, spezialisiert auf Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Industrieprojekte. Unser Fokus ist dabei klar auf die end-to-end Optimierung von produzierenden Wertschöpfungsketten unserer Kunden ausgerichtet.

Unser eigenes Team bringt vielfältige, operative Erfahrung aus Projekt- und Führungsfunktionen in Konzernen, Mittelständlern und Strategieberatungen mit, um strategisches Denken mit operativer Umsetzungsstärke zu kombinieren. Wir realisieren Projekte in den Bereichen:

  • Produktions-Footprint-Strategien und Netzwerkoptimierung
  • Aufbau und Erweiterung von Produktionskapazitäten in Greenfield- und Brownfield-Projekten
  • Internationale Produktionsverlagerungen und Standorttransformationen
  • CAPEX ramp-up-management, Operational Excellence und Performance-Steigerung

Deine Rolle

Als Senior Industrial Project Manager verantwortest du die Steuerung und Umsetzung komplexer Industrieprojekte. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass Fabrikkonzepte in funktionierende Produktionsrealität überführt werden. In dieser Rolle begleitest du unsere Kunden von größeren Maschinenprojekten bis hin zur Realisierung ganzer Fabriken. Du begleitest Projekte nicht nur aus dem Besprechungsraum heraus, sondern dort, wo industrielle Realität entsteht. Daher gehören nationale und internationale Reisetätigkeiten sowie die aktive Präsenz vor Ort in entscheidenden Projektphasen zu dieser Rolle.

Aufgaben

Das erwartet dich

1. Inhaltliche Steuerung von Industrieprojekten

  • Erfolgreiche Industrialisierung im Greenfield / Brownfield
  • Gestaltung performanter Produktionssysteme
  • Ramp-up Steuerung bis zum erfolgreichen hand-over

2. Führung von Projektteams

  • Aufbau von leistungsfähigen Projektorganisationen
  • Leitung interdisziplinärer Teams beim Kunden (Produktion, Einkauf, Logistik, Engineering etc.)
  • Coaching deiner Projektteams

3. Gestaltung eines wachsenden Unternehmensbereichs

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern zusammen und baust den Bereich Industrial Execution bei RSE+ aktiv mit auf
  • Unternehmerische Denke und Wachstum treiben dich an

The Rewarded Analytics team builds the internal dashboards, alerting systems, and data pipelines that monitor the user funnel, traffic engagement, and reward consistency.

Using Tableau as the main visualization tool, stakeholders have access to real-time insights on the product performance. Airflow orchestrates the pipelines that keep everything up to date. This team provides the data that turns questions into answers: every A/B experiment the product team runs, every anomaly a publisher flags, and every new SDK integration. jobs.title: Head of Product (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

 

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As our Head of Product (f/m/d), you'll shape what an AI-first product for the trades can become — and turn that ambition into products used by tradespeople across Europe.

We're moving beyond software that digitises administrative work towards software that increasingly does the work itself: answering calls a busy shop can't get to, turning information from the job site into quotes, keeping invoicing moving, and helping business owners understand where their attention is needed. The challenge is to make these capabilities part of one coherent product experience — not simply add AI features to an existing product.

The playbook for software that runs a trades business for its owner doesn't exist yet. You'll play a key role in shaping it.

And the timing matters: we already have a substantial customer base, we're expanding into new European markets, and we're heading into our next stage of growth. AI is fundamentally changing what's possible for our customers, while our existing scale means the decisions you make can reach real businesses quickly.

You'll lead our Product Management and UX teams and turn company strategy into focused product execution. You'll define where AI meaningfully changes the customer experience, drive priorities and trade-offs across our core product, AI capabilities, and European markets, and set the bar for products customers can trust even when the underlying technology is probabilistic.

At the same time, you'll shape how Product works at plancraft: developing a strong Product and UX organisation, bringing teams closer to customers and outcomes, and creating the clarity and ownership needed to move fast.

Your Responsibilities

  • Make AI the product, not a feature. Define where AI can fundamentally change how tradespeople run their businesses and translate those opportunities into coherent product experiences across our platform.

  • Set the bar for trustworthy AI products. Own how we approach AI quality, reliability, evaluation, and decision boundaries — ensuring customers can confidently rely on the capabilities we put into their hands.

  • Turn strategy into focus. Translate company strategy into a prioritised product portfolio and clear team outcomes, driving prioritisation and trade-off decisions across markets, platform, and AI.

  • Lead Product Management and UX as one function. Directly lead around nine PMs and designers, raise the bar on product thinking, develop their capabilities, and strengthen ownership across the organisation.

  • Build outcome-oriented product teams. Continue the shift from domains and output towards teams that own customer problems and outcomes, stay close to real tradespeople through discovery, data, and experimentation, and have the autonomy to act on what they learn.

  • Build for Europe. Scale the product across markets, balancing shared foundations with the customer and market needs that genuinely differ.

  • Create a product organisation that moves with clarity. Establish a pragmatic operating model, clear decision-making rhythms, and strong interfaces across Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM — with product and customer outcomes as the measure of success and commercial outcomes co-owned with GTM.

The scoreboard — how we'll know it's working

  • Autopilot penetration & hours given back — the share of the real work (quotes, scheduling, invoicing, materials) our AI runs end-to-end and the customer keeps — not reworks — and the admin hours that hands back to every business.

  • Net revenue retention & AI-driven expansion — customers who stay and grow because the AI pays for itself, with usage- and outcome-based revenue as new capabilities land (co-owned with GTM).

  • Time-to-first-value, in every market — how fast a new business — in Germany, Italy or Spain — reaches its first AI-sent quote or automated invoice, with onboarding that stays light.

  • Feature impact ratio — the share of what we ship that actually moves its target outcome: the number that keeps us a product team, not a feature factory.

Your Profile

  • You've led product in high-growth B2B SaaS on a similar level, with PMs — and ideally UX/design — reporting to you.

  • You've built (AI) products where the intelligence is the value — not internal productivity tooling or a bolt-on feature. You know how designing on top of probabilistic, fast-moving models changes discovery, UX, iteration, reliability, and the economics of the product.

  • You've built and scaled software products across multiple international markets, and understand how product strategy, customer needs, and execution change as the business expands.

  • You turn strategy into execution. You have a strong bias to ship, make the necessary trade-offs, and own them.

  • You've moved teams from output to outcomes and led them through meaningful organisational and product change.

  • You lead directly and pragmatically — adding structure where it helps and removing it where it doesn't.

  • You're fluent in English (C1/C2); German is a real plus. You're based in Germany and can spend around minimum a week per month with the team in Hamburg (which can also be split across the month).

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

This role is for an experienced Product leader who combines strong Product craft, organisational leadership, and a bias towards execution.

You’re comfortable moving between strategy and the actual product: shaping priorities with senior leadership, developing strong PMs and designers, challenging trade-offs, and staying close enough to customers and technology to build strong Product judgement.

You’ll thrive here if you’re excited by the opportunity to shape an AI-first product at meaningful scale, evolve how a Product organisation works, and help build a product that can serve tradespeople across Europe.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Data API)
jobs.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

 

9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through 9fin.com. But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag.

 

These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey.

 

The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy. You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors. You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data. The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer).

 

You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.

 

This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it.

 
 

What You'll Do

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Define the product vision and strategy for 9fin's external data distribution: APIs, data shares, and future delivery mechanisms (cloud sync, pub/sub).

  • Own the data catalogue decisions: which datasets to expose, in what format, through which channels, and in what order, balancing client demand, data readiness, and commercial potential

  • Design the developer experience end-to-end: API design, documentation, developer portal, sandbox/playground, error handling, rate limiting, and versioning

  • Work with analytics engineering and domain teams to define schemas, data models, and transformation logic that make 9fin's data consumable and valuable outside the application

  • Use a partner model to validate early: select and work closely with 1-2 clients during development to co-develop and prove out each data product before broader launch

  • Shape the commercial model for API products: packaging, tiering, usage-based pricing, distribution controls, and entitlement structures that capture the value of programmatic data access

 

Data Quality, Infrastructure & Compliance

 

  • Partner with the Head of Analytics to ensure data products meet the reliability, freshness, and accuracy standards that enterprise clients building automated systems expect

  • Define SLAs for data delivery (latency, uptime, completeness) and build the monitoring and metering infrastructure to back them up

  • Own the entitlements and access control layer: ensuring the right clients can access the right data under the right contractual terms, with appropriate usage limits and controls

  • Work with Legal to define data usage policies, including restrictions on redistribution, AI training and model embedding, and onward use, protecting 9fin's data IP while enabling legitimate client workflows

  • Establish feedback loops between API consumers and domain teams so that usage patterns and client requests improve the underlying data over time

 

Cross-Functional Leadership & GTM

 

  • Coordinate across platform engineering, analytics engineering, domain squads, and the Head of Analytics to align priorities and ship a cohesive product without a dedicated squad

  • Influence teams you do not manage; build relationships that make cross-functional delivery work despite competing priorities

  • Support the shift to a solution-selling GTM motion: work with Sales and Customer Success on partner selection, POC design, technical onboarding, and commercial structuring for API deals

  • Engage directly with enterprise clients and their technical teams during pilots and integrations; this is a client-facing role, not a back-office one

  • Communicate strategy, progress, and trade-offs transparently to leadership, engineering, and commercial teams

  • Translate technical API and data infrastructure concepts into language that non-technical stakeholders (Sales, Legal, Finance) can act on

 

What We're Looking For

 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years building API products, data platforms, or data distribution products at a B2B company

  • Experience designing APIs for external consumers: you have opinions on schema design, versioning strategies, rate limiting, and what makes developer documentation actually useful

  • Track record of shipping data products where you managed the full lifecycle: from defining what data to expose, through schema design, to commercial packaging and client onboarding

  • Understanding of data infrastructure concepts: data pipelines, warehouses, ETL/ELT, data modelling, and platforms like Snowflake

  • Comfortable with SQL and Python and capable of interrogating data to validate quality, understand usage patterns, and inform product decisions

  • Experience working in a solution-selling or partner-led GTM model: you have been involved in POCs, pilots, or co-development with enterprise clients, not just self-serve product launches

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functionally without a dedicated team: you coordinate across engineering, data, and commercial functions through influence, not authority

  • Strong commercial instinct: you understand how enterprise data buyers evaluate providers, and you can shape a product that competes on data quality, coverage, and ease of integration

  • Clear communicator who can translate between technical and commercial audiences

 

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with credit markets, debt instruments, or how buy-side/sell-side firms consume financial data

  • Experience with Snowflake data sharing, marketplace listings, or similar cloud data distribution mechanisms

  • Experience building entitlements, licensing, or access control systems for data products

  • Understanding of data licensing, redistribution terms, or AI usage policies in the context of enterprise data products

 

Benefits

 

  • Competitive, market-benchmarked salary

  • Pension with 7% company matching

  • Private medical insurance, paid sick leave, income protection, group life assurance

  • Season ticket and cycle-to-work schemes

  • Hybrid flexibility with up to 3 months annual work abroad

  • 25 holiday days plus local public holidays (exchangeable)

  • One-month paid sabbatical after 5 years; enhanced parental leave

  • Professional development budget and regular social events

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

jobs.title: Product Manager - SAP (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Qorelo

Almost every large company in the DACH region is facing the same task: the transformation to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point — nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI layer for S/4HANA transformation: we read code, processes and documentation, make the existing landscape transparent, and deliver the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards — including in day-to-day operations, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.

The role

You'll be the person who decides what we build next, and why. You'll lead our two solution architects — the people who carry our SAP domain depth — and turn what they know about real transformation projects into a roadmap our engineers can ship. You'll work in close collaboration with our Head of Product Design and the engineering team, and you'll spend real time with the people who use the product: consultants, IT leads, and transformation teams inside enterprise clients.

This is an early-stage PM role in the full sense: strategy and backlog, customer discovery and acceptance criteria, the big roadmap call and the unglamorous ticket. You'll do IC work alongside the thinking, and your decisions will show up in the product within weeks, running inside some of the largest SAP landscapes in Europe.

What you'll own

  • The product roadmap. You prioritize what our AI agents learn to do next across the transformation lifecycle — from fit-to-standard analysis to post-go-live evolution — and you can defend every call with customer evidence.

  • The solution architects. You lead our two SAs directly, turning their module knowledge and project scar tissue into product requirements engineering can build against.

  • Discovery with real users. Consultants and enterprise IT teams use Qorelo inside live transformation programmes. You sit with them, watch where the product wins and where it fails, and bring that back as decisions, not just notes.

  • The bridge between domain and build. SAP depth on one side, an AI-native engineering team on the other. You speak enough of both languages that nothing gets lost in translation — and you work with our Head of Product Design so what we ship is usable by SAP people, not just correct.

  • Shipping. Specs, acceptance criteria, tradeoffs, cut lines. Features reach real users on real landscapes, and you own whether they landed.

What you need

  • 4+ years hands-on SAP experience, functional or product side — S/4HANA transformation, fit-to-standard, and module-level depth in at least one core area like FI, SD, or PP

  • 2+ years product experience: you've owned a roadmap, prioritized with engineering, and shipped features to real users — title doesn't matter, ownership does

  • Understanding of the SAP transformation lifecycle (Discover → Prepare → Explore → Realize) deep enough to talk credibly to consultants and IT leads at enterprise clients

  • Strong AI curiosity — you've actually built or worked with LLM/agentic tooling, not just read about it

  • Comfort in an early-stage environment: ambiguity, speed, IC work alongside strategy

  • Fluent English; German is a plus for our DACH client base

You might be a fit if

  • You've sat inside an S/4HANA programme and thought "half of this should be software" — and can name which half

  • You've been the person consultants trust on module questions and the person engineers trust to write a clear spec

  • You've built something with LLMs — a prototype, an internal tool, an agent — and formed opinions about where they break

  • You want your product decisions to run inside DAX 40 landscapes within weeks, not sit in a committee for quarters

What we offer

  • Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in the company's direction, not just your backlog. We're looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked for senior product talent in Berlin.

  • The problems. Fortune 500 and DAX 40 production landscapes, including Mercedes-Benz. Your roadmap decisions run at the core of companies most PMs only read about.

  • The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to the engineers and architects who build what you define.

  • 25 days paid vacation plus German public holidays.

  • Company offsites with the whole team.

  • An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg. This role works from the office — product decisions here happen in the room with the architects and engineers. The fridge is stocked.

  • Wellhub membership, top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call with Reza (30 min)

  2. Deep dive on your SAP and product background with Louis, our CEO (60 min)

  3. Practical case: product exercise with the team, including our solution architects

  4. Offer

jobs.title: Account Director
Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes, expand adoption, manage change, and build long-term value with Pleo.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders while coordinating the broader Pleo relationship across Customer Success, Product, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams.

This is not a reactive account-management role. You’ll be expected to understand each customer’s business priorities, operating model, success criteria, and risk profile. You’ll turn that understanding into clear success plans, executive engagement strategies, adoption programs, renewal plans, and growth opportunities.

The right candidate will bring at least three years of direct experience managing enterprise customers, along with the communication skills, commercial judgment, and operational discipline required to manage high-value relationships in a fast-paced technology environment.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Manager of Customer Success, Large & High-Growth Customers and work closely with teams across:

  • Customer Support

  • Customer Onboarding

  • Sales and Account Management

  • Product and Product Operations

  • Revenue Operations

  • Finance

  • Data and Analytics

  • Program Management and Operations

You’ll work with customer stakeholders across finance, procurement, operations, technology, transformation, and executive leadership.

You’ll be responsible for creating alignment across these stakeholders, establishing clear governance, and ensuring Pleo remains connected to the customer’s evolving strategic and operational priorities.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will:

  • Own a portfolio of enterprise customers with accountability for customer health, value realisation, adoption, retention, renewal readiness, advocacy, and growth.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning yourself as a credible advisor who understands their business priorities and operating environment.

  • Develop detailed customer success plans that connect the customer’s strategic goals to measurable outcomes, adoption milestones, responsibilities, and timelines.

  • Lead executive business reviews and strategic customer meetings that demonstrate value, address risks, align stakeholders, and create clear next steps.

  • Drive product adoption across complex customer organisations, helping customers expand usage across teams, entities, locations, use cases, and workflows.

  • Create and maintain detailed stakeholder maps, identifying decision-makers, champions, influencers, operational contacts, blockers, and executive sponsors.

  • Identify churn risk early using product usage, engagement, stakeholder, support, financial, organisational, and external business signals.

  • Build and execute churn-prevention plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, customer commitments, and executive escalation paths.

  • Maintain detailed and accurate forecasts across renewals, risk, customer health, expected outcomes, growth opportunities, and major account milestones.

  • Lead renewal-readiness activities by ensuring customer value is documented, risks are addressed, stakeholders are aligned, and commercial partners have accurate account intelligence.

  • Identify and support expansion opportunities by connecting additional Pleo capabilities, products, or use cases to the customer’s evolving business needs.

  • Coordinate complex customer escalations across Support, Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams while maintaining clear and confident customer communication.

  • Act as the customer’s internal advocate, ensuring customer needs, feedback, risks, and opportunities are visible to the right stakeholders at Pleo.

  • Navigate customer change effectively, including leadership transitions, reorganisations, acquisitions, market expansion, platform changes, and evolving business priorities.

  • Track customer commitments and outcomes with strong operational discipline, ensuring actions are documented, owned, and completed.

  • Contribute to the evolution of Pleo’s enterprise Customer Success model by sharing best practices, customer insights, playbooks, and recommendations.

  • Support peer development and knowledge sharing across the Customer Success team without holding direct people-management responsibility.

To put things into context

In this role, you can expect to work on priorities such as:

  • strengthening relationships with Pleo’s largest and most strategic customers

  • improving enterprise customer retention and renewal predictability

  • increasing adoption across complex customer organisations

  • creating stronger executive engagement and governance

  • identifying churn risk before it becomes a renewal issue

  • improving forecast accuracy and account visibility

  • coordinating complex customer needs across multiple internal teams

  • helping customers quantify and communicate the value they receive from Pleo

  • identifying opportunities for expansion and deeper product adoption

  • improving the consistency and quality of enterprise success planning

  • helping customers navigate operational and organisational change

  • turning customer feedback into actionable Product and CX insight

You can expect to work across a technology environment that includes CRM, Customer Success platforms, support systems, product analytics, business intelligence tools, workflow tools, and collaboration platforms.

Examples may include Vitally, Gainsight or similar, Zendesk, Looker, Tableau or Power BI, Jira, Asana, and Slack.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • At least three years of direct enterprise Customer Success or strategic account-management experience, managing large, complex, and high-value B2B customers.

  • Five or more years of overall experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, implementation, or a related customer-facing role.

  • Experience working in SaaS, fintech, enterprise technology, or another complex B2B technology environment.

  • A proven record of retaining and growing enterprise customers, including managing renewals, adoption, risk, and value realisation.

  • Strong executive relationship-management skills, with the confidence and credibility to engage senior decision-makers and business leaders.

  • Experience managing complex stakeholder environments involving multiple teams, business units, regions, entities, or decision-makers.

  • Strong churn-prediction and prevention skills, including the ability to interpret customer signals, identify root causes, and build effective recovery plans.

  • Detailed forecasting experience across renewals, customer risk, account health, adoption, and expansion opportunities.

  • Strong commercial judgment, with an understanding of how customer outcomes connect to retention, revenue, expansion, and long-term account value.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to lead difficult conversations, present to executives, and simplify complex issues.

  • Experience building strategic success plans, account plans, stakeholder maps, and executive business reviews.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret customer data, product usage, service trends, and business information.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align internal stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

  • A structured and proactive approach to account management, with excellent follow-through and attention to detail.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced growth environment where customer expectations, internal priorities, and business needs can evolve quickly.

  • The ability to balance strategic relationship management with detailed operational execution.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, spend management, financial operations, or expense-management technology

  • Experience working with finance leaders, procurement teams, controllers, CFO organisations, or transformation leaders

  • Experience managing multi-country or multinational enterprise customers

  • Familiarity with ERP, accounting, procurement, or financial-system integrations

  • Experience supporting customers through significant organisational or technology transformation

  • Exposure to AI-enabled Customer Success, predictive health models, automated risk detection, or digital engagement

  • Experience partnering with Product teams on strategic customer feedback and roadmap discussions

  • Experience managing accounts with complex security, compliance, governance, or implementation requirements

Why is this role a good fit for you?

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You enjoy building strategic relationships with complex enterprise customers.

  • You are comfortable engaging senior leaders and navigating high-stakes customer situations.

  • You know how to connect product adoption to measurable customer outcomes.

  • You are proactive about identifying and addressing churn risk.

  • You combine strong relationship skills with rigorous account-management discipline.

  • You are confident leading executive reviews, renewal discussions, and difficult customer conversations.

  • You enjoy coordinating internal teams around complex customer needs.

  • You want direct responsibility for protecting and growing some of Pleo’s most important customer relationships.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You have not directly managed enterprise or strategic customer relationships.

  • You prefer transactional or high-volume customer portfolios.

  • You are uncomfortable owning customer risk, retention, and renewal readiness.

  • You prefer reacting to customer requests rather than building proactive engagement strategies.

  • You are uncomfortable engaging executive stakeholders or leading difficult conversations.

  • You do not enjoy detailed forecasting, CRM management, and account planning.

  • You prefer working independently without significant cross-functional coordination.

  • You are looking for a people-management role rather than a senior individual-contributor position.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 1 month at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Learn Pleo’s product, enterprise customer journey, value proposition, and Customer Success operating model.

  • Build a detailed understanding of your customer portfolio, including revenue, renewal dates, usage, stakeholders, open issues, risks, and growth potential.

  • Establish relationships with key customer stakeholders and internal account partners.

  • Review and improve success plans, stakeholder maps, account plans, and risk assessments.

  • Establish clear operating rhythms for customer engagement, internal coordination, and forecasting.

  • Identify immediate risks, adoption gaps, and opportunities across your portfolio.

In your first 3 months, you’ll:

  • Lead consistent executive and operational engagement across your customer portfolio.

  • Improve customer success planning, value documentation, and renewal readiness.

  • Strengthen the accuracy and detail of customer health and renewal forecasts.

  • Deliver measurable progress against adoption, engagement, and customer outcome goals.

  • Build and execute mitigation plans for at-risk customers.

  • Identify and support qualified expansion opportunities.

  • Become a trusted advisor to customer stakeholders and a reliable source of account intelligence internally.

In your first 5 months, you’ll:

  • Build a healthy and well-managed portfolio of enterprise customers.

  • Deliver strong retention and renewal performance.

  • Improve adoption and value realisation across complex customer organisations.

  • Develop trusted relationships with senior and executive customer stakeholders.

  • Demonstrate strong forecast accuracy and proactive risk management.

  • Contribute repeatable best practices and insight to Pleo’s broader enterprise Customer Success model.

  • Be recognised as a senior individual contributor capable of managing Pleo’s most important and complex customer relationships.

Success in this role looks like

  • Enterprise customers have clear success plans connected to measurable business outcomes.

  • Executive and operational customer relationships are strong and multi-threaded.

  • Customer risks are identified early and addressed through structured mitigation plans.

  • Renewal forecasts are detailed, accurate, and supported by clear account evidence.

  • Customers demonstrate stronger product adoption and value realisation.

  • Escalations are managed with urgency, clarity, and strong customer communication.

  • Internal teams are aligned around customer priorities, responsibilities, and next steps.

  • Renewal and retention performance is strong across the assigned portfolio.

  • Expansion opportunities are identified through customer value and business need rather than transactional selling.

  • Pleo is viewed as a strategic partner rather than simply a product provider.

Candidate profile summary

The strongest candidate for this role is an experienced enterprise Customer Success professional who combines senior-level relationship skills with commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and disciplined account execution.

They have at least three years of direct enterprise experience and are comfortable managing complex customers with multiple stakeholders, high expectations, and significant revenue impact.

They know how to earn executive trust, demonstrate value, predict and prevent churn, maintain accurate forecasts, and mobilise cross-functional teams around customer outcomes. They are proactive, credible, highly organised, and capable of protecting and growing Pleo’s most strategic customer relationships.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.
