jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Connectivity, C++
Director of Talent Acquisition (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Location: Role is Hybrid and based in either Berlin or Darmstadt, Germany, with remote flexibility.

Your Role

We're hiring a Director of Talent Acquisition to own how this company hires. This isn't a caretaker role over a recruiting queue. You'll lead our Talent Acquisition and Employer Branding function — a team of five TA Partners and a TA Enablement & Analytics Partner — and build the operating model that makes hiring a genuine competitive advantage.

You're joining at a pivotal moment. The TA function is operational and delivering, but quality, consistency, and hiring manager capability haven't yet caught up with our ambitions. Our ability to scale from Series A through commercialization depends on hiring the right people, at the right pace, into the right roles — across fusion science, laser engineering, software, operations, and G&A. You won't inherit a finished machine. You'll build one.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership Lead and develop five TA Partners and the TA Enablement & Analytics Partner — setting clear expectations, building capability, and creating a high-performing team culture that delivers without you in every decision.

Hiring Standards and Rigour Build and maintain the TA operating standards: hiring processes, interview frameworks, scorecards, and decision criteria applied consistently across every function. Raise the bar on quality, not just throughput.

Capacity Planning Drive capacity planning in close partnership with Finance and department heads, ensuring TA is resourced and sequenced ahead of demand — never the bottleneck to a planned hire.

Hiring Manager Enablement Equip leaders to run structured, fair hiring processes through training, coaching, and tooling — reducing dependency on TA for process guidance and raising the quality of hiring decisions.

ATS and Data Own the ATS end to end: configuration, data integrity, adoption, and continuous improvement. Use pipeline data and KPIs to identify bottlenecks, drive process changes, and report progress that drives decisions rather than decorates them.

Employer Branding Build a consistent, differentiated presence in our target talent markets — LinkedIn, Glassdoor, job boards, events, and content — in partnership with Marketing, so inbound quality improves quarter on quarter.

Who You Are

• 10+ years of progressive talent acquisition experience, with meaningful time leading and developing recruiting teams

• Experience in a scaling tech, deep-tech, or engineering-heavy environment, hiring for specialised, hard-to-fill roles

• Fluent with AI in your daily recruiting work — sourcing, screening, content, analytics — and able to raise your team's bar on it

• A KPI-driven operator: structured interviewing, assessment design, capacity planning, and hiring manager enablement are core methods, not buzzwords

• Hands-on ATS ownership: configuration, vendor management, reporting, and driving adoption across recruiters and hiring managers

• Strong working knowledge of GDPR as it applies to candidate data, and of German employment law in hiring

• Fluent in English; German is a meaningful plus

What Sets You Apart

• You've built or significantly rebuilt a TA operating model — standards, processes, and team structure — in a company that doubled headcount

• You've made employer branding work in a competitive talent market, with results you can point to

• You have a point of view on what great talent acquisition looks like — and it's grounded in outcomes, not activity

• You're drawn to mission-driven companies and want your work to connect to something larger than the next quarter

Why This Role

• Own the function that most directly gates the growth of one of the most ambitious clean energy ventures in the world

• Build the hiring engine that carries a science-driven company from Series A through commercialization

• A leadership team that treats People as a strategic function, not a support desk

• Competitive compensation, equity participation, and benefits reflective of the talent bar we hold

What We Offer

• Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

• Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you'll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

• Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

• Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

• Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

• Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

• Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

• Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

• Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

• Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs — whether it's a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing, you choose what fits your lifestyle.

• Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

jobs.description:
Intro

Auf einen Blick

  • Rolle: Werkstudent IT-Administration & Security / Werkstudent IT Support (m/w/d)

  • Unternehmen: Vivira, Digital Health, Anbieter der ersten dauerhaft gelisteten DiGA Deutschlands

  • Start: Ab sofort

  • Vergütung: 16–20 €/Stunde, je nach Erfahrung

  • Sprachen: Englisch fließend, Deutsch mindestens B1

  • Voraussetzung: Immatrikulierte/r Student/in

  • Perspektive: Echte Verantwortung, Mentoring und ein realistischer Weg in eine Festanstellung nach dem Abschluss


Hilf mit, das IT-Rückgrat eines der führenden Digital-Health-Unternehmen Deutschlands aufzubauen.


Bei Vivira machst Du weit mehr, als Passwörter zurückzusetzen oder Laptops einzurichten. Als Werkstudent im Bereich IT & Security sorgst Du mit dafür, dass ein schnell wachsendes Digital-Health-Unternehmen in Berlin jeden Tag reibungslos läuft: vom Onboarding neuer Kolleginnen und Kollegen über die Verwaltung moderner SaaS-Anwendungen bis zur Unterstützung unserer Security-Infrastruktur.


Du arbeitest Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, sammelst praktische Erfahrung in einer modernen, cloudbasierten Umgebung und trägst zu einer Technologie bei, die Tausenden von Patientinnen und Patienten hilft, ihre Rückenschmerzen in den Griff zu bekommen, mit Deutschlands erster dauerhaft erstattungsfähiger Digitaler Gesundheitsanwendung (DiGA).


Wenn Du Informatik (oder ein verwandtes Fach) studierst und echte Praxiserfahrung in IT & Security sammeln willst statt nur eines Praktikumstitels, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.


Deine Aufgaben umfassen

  • IT-Helpdesk & Technischer Support: Du unterstützt den Vivira IT-Helpdesk und leistest remote sowie vor Ort First-Level-Support bei Software, Tools und allgemeinem Troubleshooting.

  • Infrastruktur vor Ort: Manche Aufgaben lassen sich remote erledigen, regelmäßig bist Du aber in unserem Office im Mindspace Stadtmitte, um bei IT-Hardware und Security-Infrastruktur tatkräftig anzupacken.

  • On- & Offboarding: Du unterstützt das IT-On- und Offboarding, von der physischen Einrichtung des Offices über die Vorbereitung der Hardware für neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen bis zur Rücknahme bei ausscheidenden.

  • SaaS-Administration: Du hilfst bei der Verwaltung verschiedener SaaS-Anwendungen, Benutzerkonten und Zugriffsrechte.

  • Hardware-Wartung: Du kümmerst Dich mit um Reparaturen und Austausch von Geräten, damit unser Team immer gut ausgestattet ist.

  • Netzwerk-Infrastruktur: Du unterstützt das Monitoring unserer Netzwerk-Infrastruktur, inklusive Firewalls, Routern und VPN-Lösungen.

  • Dokumentation: Du hilfst dabei, Systemkonfigurationen, Richtlinien und Prozesse aktuell zu halten.

  • IT-Security: Du unterstützt Security-Initiativen wie Access Management, Endpoint Security, MFA und Device Compliance.


Das lernst Du bei uns

Praxiserfahrung, über die die meisten Studierenden nur in Vorlesungen lesen:

  • Moderne Apple-/macOS-Administration & Endpoint Management (MDM)

  • Cloudbasierte IT-Infrastruktur und SaaS-Administration

  • Identity & Access Management (IAM) und Grundlagen der IT-Security

  • Device Lifecycle Management

  • IT-Betrieb in einem regulierten Digital-Health-Umfeld

  • Support für verteilte, remote-first arbeitende Teams

Du arbeitest mit einem modernen, cloud-first Toolset, darunter MDM für unsere Apple-Flotte, Single Sign-on und IAM, eine führende Productivity Suite sowie aktuelle Endpoint-Security- und Netzwerk-Lösungen. Den kompletten Stack stellen wir Dir im ersten Gespräch vor.


Das solltest Du mitbringen

  • Du bist aktuell in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem anderen technischen Studiengang an einer Hochschule in Berlin oder Umgebung immatrikuliert.

  • Du kannst regelmäßig aus unserem Office im Mindspace Stadtmitte arbeiten, mitten im Zentrum von Berlin.

  • Du hast ein solides Verständnis von macOS und Freude daran, technische Probleme zu lösen.

  • Du interessierst Dich für IT-Administration, Infrastruktur und Informationssicherheit.

  • Du hilfst gerne und kommunizierst freundlich und serviceorientiert.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und proaktiv.

  • Du sprichst fließend Englisch und hast mindestens Deutschkenntnisse auf B1-Niveau, da Du regelmäßig Kolleginnen und Kollegen vor Ort unterstützt.

  • Erste Erfahrung durch eigene Projekte, Praktika oder Studentenjobs (Werkstudent, HiWi, IT-Support) ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.


Das erwartet Dich bei Vivira

  • Vergütung: 16–20 € pro Stunde, je nach Erfahrung, für eine 20-Stunden-Werkstudentenstelle, die sich an Dein Studium anpasst.

  • Flexibilität: Arbeitszeiten, die sich nach Deinem Vorlesungsplan und Deinen Prüfungsphasen richten.

  • Arbeitsplatz: Arbeite von Zuhause oder aus unserem Berliner HQ in zentraler Lage (Mindspace Stadtmitte), mit hochwertiger Apple-Hardware.

  • Recharge: Bezahlte Urlaubstage für echte Pausen und neue Energie.

  • Gesundheit: Beweglichkeit und Rückenpower direkt von uns für Dich, mit digitaler Unterstützung, die Du selbst nutzen kannst.

  • Corporate Benefits: Profitiere von exklusiven Vorteilen für Shopping, Technik & mehr.

  • Empfehlungsprämie: Netzwerk teilen lohnt sich. Jede erfolgreiche Empfehlung wird belohnt.

  • Highlights: Mehrere Company- und Team-Events pro Jahr sorgen für Austausch, Spaß und ein echtes Wir-Gefühl.

  • Echte Verantwortung: Ownership ab Tag eins, flache Hierarchien und erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die sich Zeit für Dein Mentoring nehmen.

  • Echte Perspektive: Leistungsstarke Werkstudierende werden regelmäßig für Festanstellungen nach dem Abschluss berücksichtigt.


Gut zu wissen

  • Wie viele Stunden pro Woche? 20 Stunden im Semester, flexibel rund um Dein Studium geplant.

  • Wo ist der Job? In Berlin-Mitte im Mindspace Stadtmitte, mit hybridem Setup: Du arbeitest teils vor Ort, teils remote.

  • Muss ich Deutsch sprechen? Deutsch auf B1-Niveau reicht aus; unsere Arbeitssprache ist Englisch.

  • Brauche ich Berufserfahrung? Nein. Echtes Interesse an IT-Administration und Security plus solide macOS-Kenntnisse sind das, was zählt.

  • Kann daraus ein Vollzeitjob werden? Ja. Leistungsstarke Werkstudierende erhalten regelmäßig Festanstellungsangebote nach dem Abschluss.


Über Vivira


ViViRA. Simply move.


Vivira entwickelt digitale Gesundheitsversorgung mit echtem Impact. Unsere App ist Deutschlands erste dauerhaft gelistete Digitale Gesundheitsanwendung (DiGA) gegen Rückenschmerzen und offiziell im BfArM-Verzeichnis erstattungsfähiger Anwendungen gelistet. Jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt in Deutschland kann Vivira verordnen, die Kosten übernimmt vollständig die gesetzliche Krankenversicherung.


Wir sind ein internationales, schnell wachsendes Team mit Sitz in Berlin, vereint durch den Anspruch, Gesundheitsversorgung zugänglicher, wirksamer und menschlicher zu machen.


So bewirbst Du Dich


Schick uns einfach Deinen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben brauchst Du nicht. Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage bei Dir. Der Prozess ist kurz: ein Kennenlern-Call, ein praxisnahes Gespräch mit dem Team und dann die Entscheidung.


Bewirb Dich jetzt und hilf mit, die IT am Laufen zu halten, die digitale Gesundheitsversorgung möglich macht.

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

The Role

We're looking for a City Scout to help build the most reliable database of work-friendly cafes for travellers across the UK.

You'll visit cafes across your assigned city, verify information like WiFi quality, internet speed, plug points and overall work-friendliness, and submit accurate data that powers a new Atlys product. Every visit directly improves the travel experience for thousands of users.

Hiring in: London.

 

The Job

  • Explore and discover great cafes: Visit assigned cafes across your city, experience them as a customer, and identify places that travellers would genuinely enjoy working from.

  • Collect high-quality on-ground data: Verify key details including WiFi availability, internet speed, passwords, plug points, seating, ambience and overall work-friendliness to ensure the information is accurate and reliable.

  • Contribute to a travel product used by thousands: Capture your observations by completing a short digital survey after every visit, helping build one of the world's most reliable databases of work-friendly cafes.

  • Cover your city efficiently: Plan your visits across assigned neighbourhood clusters to maximize coverage while maintaining consistency and quality.

  • Maintain exceptional data quality: Pay close attention to detail, validate every submission, and ensure the information travellers see on the Atlys app can be trusted.

The Ideal Candidate

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are a college student or have a flexible part-time schedule.

  • Enjoy exploring your city and discovering new places.

  • Have strong attention to detail and collect information accurately.

  • Are comfortable travelling independently within your city.

  • Own a smartphone and are reliable, proactive and self-driven.

What you can expect

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

  • Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

  • A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.

  • Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

  • Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

  • Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.

  • An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

Your Mission at plancraft

We're building plancraft towards an agentic-first product experience. That means AI-enabled capabilities our customers actually use: features that take real administrative work off a tradesperson's plate and hold up under production load, day after day.

Building AI-enabled products that work reliably at scale requires strong engineering foundations. You'll help shape those foundations — from architecture and system design to engineering practices — while keeping the focus on what we're ultimately building for our customers.

This is an individual contributor role with no disciplinary leadership but significant influence across Engineering. You'll work hands-on where it matters, shape technical direction across teams, and help other engineers build better systems.

We have a clear vision for how we want to build software and the outcomes we want to achieve, while recognising that we're still on the journey to get there. Some foundations are already in place; others are still evolving. We're looking for someone who has built and scaled complex systems before and can bring that experience into what we build.

Our customers are tradespeople. Every hour they spend on paperwork is an hour off the job site. We keep that in mind when making technical decisions: the systems we build should ultimately help us take more work off their plate.

Your Responsibilities

  • AI-enabled product capabilities. You'll help define what AI can meaningfully do for our customers and turn emerging capabilities into reliable, observable product experiences that work beyond the demo.

  • The wider technical system. Together with our other Staff Engineers, you'll shape architectural direction and the properties that should hold across teams, while enabling individual teams to build and ship independently.

  • Data foundations for AI-enabled workflows. You’ll help turn product and business data into meaningful signals, insights, and context that AI can use reliably in customer-facing workflows — from defining the right data models and semantics, and drawing a clear line between operational data and knowledge, to making that understanding available where it creates real product value.

  • How we build with AI. You'll influence both how we develop and evaluate customer-facing AI capabilities and how AI changes software engineering itself — from tooling and workflows to standards and practices across the organisation.

How you'll work & influence

We have clear engineering principles, but we expect our Staff Engineers to challenge and evolve them. We favour small, integrated changes, observable systems that recover quickly, explicit architectural boundaries, and engineering decisions that are encoded rather than repeatedly debated. Above all, engineers own customer problems — not tickets.

You'll have meaningful autonomy from the start:

  • Shape technical direction. You'll evolve shared architecture and engineering standards through RFCs and ADRs, not by waiting for top-down decisions.

  • Own complex initiatives end to end. From discovery and technical design through implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Influence where Engineering invests. You'll help identify the technical capabilities, architectural improvements, and engineering practices worth investing in.

  • Raise the bar across teams. You'll shape architecture, developer experience, AI-enabled engineering practices, and codebase quality beyond your immediate team.

  • Multiply other engineers. You'll mentor through collaboration, architectural guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

How hands-on you are depends on the problem. Some weeks you'll be deep in the code; others you'll focus on system design, technical discovery, or mentoring across teams. We care about the technical outcomes you create, not your commit count.

Your Profile

  • Experience building and operating real production systems. You've designed, shipped, and lived with complex systems at scale — whether distributed architectures, asynchronous or multi-step workflows, event-driven services, data pipelines, or ETL pipelines. You understand reliability and observability because you've needed them in practice. You bring 5+ years of software engineering experience and a track record of technical leadership.

  • Strong typed-language fundamentals — and a polyglot mindset. You understand the concepts that make a strong type system valuable and use them to keep a growing codebase understandable and maintainable. Our stack is React on the frontend, serverless Node.js / Express on the backend, and GCP underneath — all TypeScript, so you're either productive in TypeScript or able to get there quickly. Where your deepest expertise sits matters less: if that's Rust, Go, Kotlin, or something else, we see it as a strength. Having worked across several languages and paradigms tends to reduce stack bias exactly when systems thinking matters most. Experience with another modern cloud environment is absolutely fine.

  • Information systems thinking. You distinguish clearly between operational data and knowledge — the transactional state that runs the business versus the modelled, contextual understanding that AI-enabled workflows depend on — and you design deliberately for both. In an agentic product, that distinction is a practical necessity, not a theoretical one.

  • Strong system design and domain modelling skills. You know how to create clear boundaries, model business concepts explicitly, and design systems that can evolve without every change becoming expensive. Techniques such as dependency injection, adapters, making invalid states unrepresentable, and parse-don’t-validate are tools you’ve applied rather than concepts you’ve only read about.

  • Strong product thinking. You start with the problem rather than the technology, use evidence to understand customer needs, and make deliberate trade-offs between technical excellence, speed, and product outcomes.

  • Technical leadership beyond your own work. You've influenced technical direction across teams, mentored other engineers, and can align Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

  • AI is already part of how you work. You use tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex seriously, understand where they help and where they don't, and can help others adopt them effectively.

  • A T-shaped engineering profile. You bring broad engineering judgment across product and system challenges, with genuine depth in at least one area.

  • C1 English. German is a plus, not a must.

Prior experience building AI or ML capabilities is a huge plus — including work from before the LLM era — but it's not a fixed requirement. Deep production engineering experience and the ability to apply it to AI-enabled products matter more than expertise in a specific model or framework.

Who this role is for

This role is for someone who wants to operate as a senior individual contributor with broad technical influence — without people management. You won’t be the only Staff Engineer: we currently have four Staff Engineers and are looking for great additions to the group. You’ll work closely with Engineering Managers who steward people, team environment and flow while you steward the technical system and direction.

You’ll enjoy this role if you like moving across product, architecture, engineering practices and AI-enabled ways of working — and if you prefer shaping systems and standards across teams over specialising deeply in one narrow technology or domain.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Note on creating a test account:
If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.

GESIS – Leibniz-Institut für Sozialwissenschaften ist eine von Bund und Ländern finanzierte, international tätige sozialwissenschaftliche Einrichtung der Leibniz-Gemeinschaft. 

 
Wir suchen zum 01.10.2026 für den Standort Mannheim für die Abteilung Data and Research on Society, Team German Microdata Lab eine*n
 

Studentische Hilfskraft

(15,20 € / 16,09 € Stundenlohn, 36 Wochenstunden, befristet)
 

Die Beobachtung aktueller gesellschaftlicher Entwicklungen ist eine Kernaufgabe der Sozialwissenschaften. Die Abteilung Data and Research on Society unterstützt die Sozialforschung bei dieser Aufgabe, indem sie umfassende Daten und Tools zur Beschreibung und Analyse des sozialen Wandels bereitstellt.

Das German Microdata Lab (GML) wirkt als Schnittstelle zwischen empirischer Sozialforschung und amtlicher Statistik. Wir bereiten die Daten der amtlichen Statistik auf und bieten einen umfangreichen forschungsbasierten Service zu diesen Daten an.


Ihr Aufgabengebiet:

  • Mitarbeit bei der Aufbereitung und Dokumentation von Daten des European Labour Force Survey (EU-LFS)
  • Literaturrecherche und -aufbereitung
  • Unterstützung bei Forschungstätigkeiten


Ihr Profil:

  • Sehr sorgfältige, zuverlässige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Gute Kenntnisse in R, Stata oder einem anderen Statistikprogramm
  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Aufbereitung und Analyse von Daten
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Interesse an einer längerfristigen Beschäftigung
  • Student*in eines sozialwissenschaftlichen BA- oder idealerweise MA-Studiengangs


Wir bieten:

  • Einblicke in die Arbeit eines Forschungsdatenzentrums und die Potenziale amtlicher Mikrodaten für die empirische Sozialforschung
  • Sehr gute Arbeitsatmosphäre
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Regelungen zum mobilen Arbeiten
  • Sehr gute Bedingungen für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie 
  • Ganzheitliches Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement und die vergünstigte Teilnahme am Sportprogramm der Uni 
  • Förderung Ihrer Kompetenzen durch Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen


Kontakt

Für weitere Informationen zu den Aufgabengebieten wenden Sie sich bitte per E-Mail () an Frau Dr. Andrea Lengerer. Bei Fragen zum Bewerbungsprozess steht Ihnen Michaela Kurtov per E-Mail () zur Verfügung.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Germany (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Qorelo

Almost every large company in the DACH region is facing the same task: the transformation to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point — nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI layer for S/4HANA transformation: we read code, processes and documentation, make the existing landscape transparent, and deliver the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards — including in day-to-day operations, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz, and we sell to enterprise customers across DACH as well as to selected SAP consultancies who use Qorelo in their own client projects.

The role

You will be one of the first sellers on the team, and you own your accounts end to end — from first touch to signature. We have a product with a clear business case, a defined target market, a pricing model that holds up, and a sales playbook you can run from day one. What we need is someone who turns that into pipeline and revenue.

You will work closely with the Head of Sales, as well as with product and our engineers, and you will have a direct line to the people who build what you sell.

What you'll own

  • The full sales cycle. You build your own pipeline, qualify, run discovery and demos, drive the Proof of Value and negotiate the close — no SDR teeing it up for you, no handover to a closing team.

  • Selling to decision makers. CIOs, Heads of SAP, transformation leads and procurement — you get them into the same room.

  • MEDDICC as your sales motion. You quantify the business case in the customer's own numbers (Metrics), get to the Economic buyer instead of stopping at the sponsor, understand the Decision criteria and the Decision process including procurement, security and works council, map the Paper process early, qualify the Identified pain hard enough to know whether the deal is real, build a Champion who sells internally when you are not in the room, and position against the Competition — including the customer's option to do nothing.

  • Honest qualification. MEDDICC is how we forecast, not paperwork. Gaps in your deal are visible in the CRM, and walking away from a deal that will not close is a good outcome, not a failure.

  • Technical sales cycles. You steer fit-to-standard Proof of Value engagements, security and data protection reviews, and questions around on-premise and cloud deployment together with our team.

  • Negotiating and closing. Multi-year agreements, framework contracts, ramp deals, procurement rounds — you hold the line on value instead of discounting your way to a signature.

  • A forecast we can plan on. You keep Attio, our CRM, clean and current, and your forecast holds up.


What you need

  • Several years of SaaS sales experience selling to enterprise customers with multi-month sales cycles

  • A demonstrable track record of not just hitting but exceeding ambitious revenue targets — you can walk us through your numbers for the past few years

  • Ownership mentality: you run the full sales cycle from first outreach to signed contract

  • Confident negotiation at executive level in German and English (German at native level)

  • Experience selling AI products and the ability to translate technical value into a business case that survives a CFO review

  • You use AI tools in your day-to-day sales work — research, prep, outreach, follow-up — and you are curious about what they can take off your plate next

  • Self-driven pipeline generation: outbound, network, events — you do not wait for leads

  • Willingness to travel within DACH for on-site customer meetings


You might be a fit if

  • You have worked with MEDDICC or another structured qualification framework, and you can tell us not only where it helped you close a deal, but where it helped you drop one early

  • You know the SAP ecosystem — or you have sold into complex, technical evaluation processes and learned the domain fast

  • You have been an early sales hire at a fast-growing startup and want that again, with more ownership

  • You have an existing network among IT decision makers in DACH


What we offer

  • Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in the company's direction, not just your quota. We're looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

  • Competitive salary with uncapped commission — your ceiling is set by your pipeline, not by a plan.

  • A market with a deadline. Moving to S/4HANA is not optional for thousands of companies, and the product you sell solves a problem enterprises cannot solve on their own — with Mercedes-Benz already proving it in production.

  • The team. Short paths, fast decisions, real influence on product and go-to-market, and a direct line to the engineers who build what you sell.

  • 25 days paid vacation plus region-specific public holidays.

  • Company offsites with the whole team.

  • An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg — and the flexibility to work where you are most effective. The fridge is stocked.

  • Wellhub Gold membership, top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools.


Hiring process

  1. Intro call with Reza (30 min)

  2. Deep dive on your track record and sales methodology with Marcel, our Head of Sales (60 min)

  3. Practical case: discovery and pitch simulation with Marcel and Louis, our CEO

  4. Offer


How to apply

Send us your CV at ----- — no cover letter needed, but we would love two or three sentences about your strongest deal of the past two years.

Qorelo is an equal opportunity employer. We make our decisions regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, disability or sexual identity.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer | Voice
jobs.description:
We’re seeking a driven Senior AI Voice Engineer to join one of the fastest-growing legal tech companies in Europe as we expand our core AI team delivering ‘Marie’, our AI phone assistant.

This role focuses on production voice AI systems operating over real telephony infrastructure: building, maintaining, and scaling phone agents that handle real customer conversations at production volume. You'll own the complete voice stack, from telephony and speech systems through to LLM orchestration, tooling, evaluation, and observability.

Reporting to the AI Lead, you’ll work hands-on from architecture to implementation, collaborating with the Head of Engineering and product teams to ship reliable AI functionality while improving our voice infrastructure, evaluation workflows, and AI platform capabilities.

For an engineer who has personally shipped production phone agents and end-to-end LLM-powered products, this is an opportunity to take technical ownership of Marie, ship quickly, and shape how voice AI evolves across the company.

Your Challenge and Opportunity in This Role

You’ll help define how voice AI is built and operated in a fast-moving product environment. As a core Senior AI Voice Engineer, you’ll turn modern voice and generative AI technologies into production-ready systems that deliver real value to users.

Your primary goal will be to maintain, improve, and expand our phonebot platform. Expect strong technical ownership, fast iteration, and a clear focus on building reliable voice systems that operate effectively in real-world telephony environments.

Tasks:

AI Strategy & Implementation:

  • Architect and implement production-ready generative voice AI solutions within our product suite

  • Develop voice-based AI systems, integrating speech technologies such as ASR/STT and TTS into conversational workflows

  • Design and optimize real-time voice agent workflows, balancing latency, reliability, and conversational quality

  • Architect and implement production-ready generative AI and LLM-based solutions to power voice experiences end-to-end

  • Implement evaluation, testing, and observability for AI systems to ensure reliability and continuous improvement

  • Establish best practices for AI development, testing, and deployment across products

  • Handle AI development hands-on as a core technical contributor within a small, fast-moving team where engineers own problems end-to-end and ship quickly

Cross-functional Collaboration:

  • Work closely with product, design, and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into real product workflows

  • Partner with stakeholders to define and improve user experiences across voice, telephony, and AI-driven interactions

  • Translate complex AI concepts into practical product features and communicate them clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Requirements:

Technical Expertise:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience

  • 1–2+ years of hands-on experience building and operating production Voice AI systems

  • Proven experience building and shipping production phone agents handling real users and real phone calls

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major voice-agent framework or provider such as LiveKit Agents, Vapi, Pipecat, Retell, Daily Bots, Bland, OpenAI Realtime, Twilio, Telnyx, Deepgram, Soniox, ElevenLabs, or Cartesia

  • Strong understanding of the complete voice pipeline, including STT, LLM orchestration, TTS, turn-taking, interruption handling, and latency optimization

  • Strong understanding of telephony concepts including PSTN, SIP, and WebRTC

  • Experience building LLM-powered products end-to-end, including prompt engineering, RAG, tool/function calling, model selection, and evaluation

  • Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tools and designing evaluation pipelines for AI systems

  • Strong programming skills in Python and solid software engineering practices

  • Experience implementing AI systems in real production environments, not purely research or academic settings

Nice to Have:

  • Experience operating high-volume outbound calling systems, including concurrency management, retries, and compliance considerations

  • Experience deploying OpenAI Realtime API or Gemini Live into production environments

  • Experience with voice evaluation and observability platforms or custom evaluation frameworks

  • Fluency or working proficiency in European languages such as German, French, Spanish, or Italian

  • Experience contributing to or participating in voice AI communities and open-source projects

Note:

  • You must be located in the CET -2/+2 timezone for this role, and we do not support relocation or visa sponsorship.

Benefits

🚀 Foundational Impact – Help build and scale the core AI capabilities of JUPUS from the ground up

🔒 Technical Ownership – Work directly on the systems powering AI features across multiple products

🌱 Growth Environment – Build production AI systems at the cutting edge of generative AI and agentic workflows

💼 Leadership Visibility – Flat hierarchy with direct access to the Head of Engineering and CTO, reporting to the AI Lead

🏡 Fully Remote – Enjoy the flexibility of working from anywhere

💻 Top Equipment – State-of-the-art MacBook plus all the accessories you need

🏋️ Wellbeing Perks – Urban Sports Club membership to support your healthy lifestyle

If you're passionate about building production voice agents, solving real-world telephony challenges, and creating intelligent AI systems that users rely on every day, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Batch Robotics is revolutionizing how robots operate in factories — not through rigid programming or teaching by human demonstration, but with smart perception and AI intelligence. We are a team of 4 motivated people with +25 years of experience in industry and robotics. Our mission is to make robots smarter and more flexible, enabling batch-size-1 automation for surface treatment economically.

We are now looking for a Working Student / Werkstudent (m/f/d) to get hands-on with our robot systems. You will build, wire, and see hardware run in a real factory, working directly with our engineers and founders in our Munich lab.

Tasks

  • Build & Wire: Assemble our robot cells — mount cobots, cameras and sensors, wire control cabinets, crimp cables, solder, and get the system powered up and running.
  • Electronics & Measurement: Read and extend electrical schematics, select components, and debug with multimeter and oscilloscope until the signal is where it should be.
  • Test & Script: Run bring-up and end-of-line tests, document what fails, and write small Python tools to talk to sensors, log data and automate repetitive steps.
  • Prototype & Supply: Design and 3D-print mounts and adapters (we will teach you the CAD work), order components, and keep our lab and hardware stock in shape.

Requirements

  • Studies: Enrolled in Electrical Engineering / Elektrotechnik, Mechatronics, Robotics or a related field at a Munich university — and staying enrolled for at least 6 more months.
  • Hands-On by Nature: You build things outside of lectures — Formula Student, rocketry, a makerspace, RC models, a self-built PCB. You have actually held a soldering iron and a multimeter.
  • Electrical Fundamentals: Comfortable with schematics, wiring and basic measurement gear. 24 V industrial wiring, control cabinets or fieldbuses are a plus, not a requirement.
  • Programming Skills: You know your way around Linux and can write a Python script.
  • Availability & Mindset: ~20 h/week during the semester, ideally in full days, flexible in the breaks, on-site in Munich. Curious, reliable, and not scared by a system that does not work yet.

Benefits

  • Real Hardware, Real Factories: You work on the systems we ship to customers, not on a training project — and you can join us on a deployment to see them run on a factory floor.
  • Learn from Experts: Direct mentoring from founders and engineers with +25 years in industry and robotics — short feedback loops, no layers in between.
  • Ownership & Path Forward: Your own topics from day one, a natural route into a Bachelor’s or Master’s thesis, and — if it fits both sides — a permanent role after your studies.
  • Environment & Pay: A modern, central workspace in Munich, a well-equipped lab, an international team (working language English), and €16–18/h depending on experience.

Want to shape the future of industrial robotics? Send us your CV — a cover letter is not required. Tell us in two sentences what you have built with your own hands. We reply quickly and the process is short: a 20-minute intro call, then a visit to our lab in Munich so you can see the systems and meet the team.

jobs.title: Product Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants on a tap, send money to friends, track their spending, and earn loyalty rewards along the way. As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people actually use it. As the tribe scales, so does the need for sharp, reliable insight into how people actually use what we build.

We're looking for a Product Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer — working closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers, and alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and measure what matters.

If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence product decisions — this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance for SumUp Consumer using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation, and behavioural analytics to identify opportunities and drive improvements
  • Support Product Managers in understanding customer journeys, engagement, conversion, and retention — helping to shape product strategy and priorities
  • Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Define, monitor, and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs — covering activation, engagement, and retention — and evaluate the impact of product changes for stakeholders
  • Design, execute, and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, helping to embed a culture of experimentation across the Consumer tribe
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, and growth opportunities before they're asked for
  • Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic, and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable, and trusted
  • Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation and product measurement
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and Data teams to ground decisions in robust analysis and customer insight

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing, and validating data in a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar)
  • You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and segmentation
  • You've worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them
  • You're proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use
  • You can translate ambiguous business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike
  • You're curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, and customer understanding
  • You're comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work in a truly global, multicultural team from our open, vibrant Cologne office, located in the heart of the city. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🚗 Commute made easy: subsidised mobility options like discounted transport tickets or bike leasing

💪 Stay active: access to fitness via Urban Sports Club, mostly covered by SumUp

💰 Financial health: a corporate pension scheme with SumUp contributing an extra 20% on top of your contribution

🎁 Employee perks: get discounts across products and services via our Corporate Benefits platform

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset.     • Visitor Management: Warmly welcome guests, candidates, and visiting international colleagues, ensuring they have an exceptional on-site experience.

      • Event Coordination: Take a lead role in bringing our team together by planning and organizing weekly team lunches, office celebrations, seasonal parties, and cultural events.

      • Community Building: Act as a culture champion, brainstorming new ideas to make the Berlin office an inspiring and fun place to work.

        • Administration & Onboarding Logistics

  • Communication Skills: Fluency in English (our company language) and a strong command of German (essential for communicating with local suppliers, landlords, and German administrative bodies).

Unsere Produkte sind gefragt. Du baust ein paselo Expertennetzwerk auf, die unsere Produkte empfehlen, wenn sie überzeugt sind.

Damit eins klar ist: Am Anfang ist das zu 70 % Telefon. Du recherchierst, du rufst an, du sprichst mit Menschen, die dich nicht erwartet haben. Du wirst öfter ein Nein hören als ein Ja. Wenn dich das abschreckt, ist die Rolle nichts für dich. Wenn dich das reizt, weil du weißt, dass genau hier der Unterschied entsteht.

  • Ownership statt Zuarbeit. Das Partnerprogramm ist deins – von der Zielgruppen-Definition über die Ansprache bis zur Betreuung der ersten Partner. Du bist nicht die Verstärkung für ein bestehendes Team. Du bist das Team.
  • Kaltakquise am Telefon. Du erklärst in 30 Sekunden, warum sich das Gespräch für sie lohnt. Du gehst mit einem konkreten nächsten Schritt raus, nicht mit einem „Schicken Sie mir mal was".
  • Pipeline bauen und pflegen. Du recherchierst Leads, qualifizierst sie und hältst nach.

  • Partner aktivieren. Ein unterschriebener Partner, der nichts empfiehlt, ist kein Partner. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Zusagen Umsatz wird.
  • Zahlen im Blick. Kontaktierte Personen, Gesprächsquote, Abschlüsse, Umsatz pro Partner. Du misst deine eigene Arbeit, bevor wir danach fragen.

Qualifikation

  • Eingeschriebener Student. Fachrichtung egal. BWL hilft nicht mehr als Tiermedizin oder Germanistik.

  • Frustrationstoleranz. Zwanzig Absagen bringen dich nicht aus dem Konzept. Du analysierst, was schiefgelaufen ist, und wählst die nächste Nummer.

jobs.title: Agentic Software Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world's leading AI code review and verification platform.

  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.

  • Obsessed with quality.

  • Deliberate in our decisions.

  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you're hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.


What you will do

  • Spend the majority of your time (roughly 70%) designing, building, and iterating on agentic tooling: orchestration, tool-use, context management, and evaluation harnesses for autonomous code-modification agents.

  • Build and refine the verification layer that gates what agents are allowed to ship — automated test generation, regression detection, static analysis (using our own SonarQube), and human-in-the-loop checkpoints where warranted.

  • Spend the remainder of your time (roughly 30%) hands-on in our Java/Spring codebase: reviewing agent-generated pull requests, fixing what they get wrong, and feeding those lessons back into the tooling.

  • Partner closely with the Server, Cloud Platform, and value-stream squads whose domains you're migrating — earning their trust and buy-in matters as much as the code itself.

  • Contribute to the Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and standards that govern how the Unified Core evolves.

  • Track and evaluate emerging agent frameworks and techniques, bringing back what's genuinely useful — as distinct from what's just hype — for accelerating engineering across Sonar.


Experience and qualifications

  • Hands-on experience building or operating multi-agent or LLM-agent systems in a real production setting — not just prompting a coding assistant, but designing the orchestration, tool-use, and guardrails around autonomous agents.

  • Experience building evaluation or verification systems for AI-generated changes: automated testing, static analysis, regression detection, or comparable safety nets for code you didn't personally write.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals in Java and Spring (or a comparable JVM/enterprise stack) — enough to read a large, mature codebase critically and tell good architecture from bad.

  • A track record of owning complex, ambiguous technical problems independently and driving them to resolution — this is an R&D-flavored role inside a production platform team, and you'll be shaping the playbook, not following one.

  • Experience influencing engineers and squads you don't manage — the migrations you'll enable depend on their trust as much as on your code.

  • Pension Scheme:2nd Pillar (bAV): Voluntary, 15% contribution by Sonar from social security savings.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
SoSafe is shifting from a broad-market approach to a deliberate, segment-led GTM model. This role is central to that transition. As Manager of Segment & Solutions Marketing, you will own the positioning, messaging, and solution architecture for SoSafe's priority segments. These can be defined by geography, industry vertical, customer lifecycle stage, or Human Risk maturity.

We have a foundation to build from: a defined maturity model that maps how organisations progress in their Human Risk journey, a growing understanding of how customer needs differ across lifecycle stages and a set of priority markets and geographies. What we don't yet have is the messaging, the plays, and the product experience layer that makes those segments feel served

Your role is to and translate that work into measurable improvements in win rates, market penetration, and net revenue retention. This is a newly created role in Product Marketing that you’ll have influence to shape and will work in close partnership with GTM, Product, Sales, CS, and the Commercial Centre of Excellence.

Location: This role can be fully remote from anywhere in Germany, or hybrid from one of our offices in Cologne, Munich or Berlin.

Segmented Messaging

  • Own messaging for defined priority segments — including lifecycle stage (new business, upsell, cross-sell, retention), maturity tier, geography, and industry vertical (e.g. financial services, manufacturing)

  • Develop segment-specific value propositions written in buyer language: the situation they face, the consequence of inaction, how SoSafe solves it, and why SoSafe over alternatives without jargon, no feature lists

  • Use AI tools to accelerate research, messaging iteration, persona development, and competitive synthesis as a standard part of your workflow

  • Maintain and evolve messaging as product capabilities, customer insights, and the competitive landscape shift — keeping SoSafe's market fit current and differentiated

  • Monitor industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitive dynamics to proactively inform segment strategy and portfolio planning

Solution Development

  • Define solution sets for priority segments: which SoSafe capabilities address their most pressing needs, framed around business outcomes rather than product features

  • Process voice-of-customer research, win/loss data, competitive intelligence, and regulatory context into compelling segment narratives and solution architectures

  • Partner with the Commercial CoE to inform pricing, packaging, bundling, and programme decisions — contributing market and segment evidence to commercial recommendations that drive share within defined segments

GTM Readiness

  • Develop SPICED-aligned talk tracks for each priority segment, grounding rep conversations in the buyer's situation before working back to solution language

  • Build and maintain a library of scalable, reusable field assets e.g. solution briefs, demo scripts, battle cards, objection-handling guides, buyer and implementation guides — leveraging AI to produce, iterate, and personalise at speed

  • Validate messaging and demo content before market release through structured rep feedback sessions, customer interviews, and early cohort exposure

  • Input into coordinated multi-touch plays across Marketing, Sales, and CS that drive upsell and cross-sell into the install base — with clear pipeline and NRR impact metrics tied to each play

  • Track asset utilisation, field feedback, and segment performance data (win rates, pipeline velocity, NRR contribution) to continuously improve GTM effectiveness and demonstrate commercial impact


What you will bring

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS in product marketing, solutions marketing or segment marketing with a proven track record of producing segment-specific or lifecycle-specific positioning

  • Demonstrated ability to write in buyer language: situation, problem, solution, outcome - not functional feature lists

  • Proficiency with competitive intelligence tools and a bias towards activating insight into sales & field-facing content, enriching the quality of their conversations

  • Proven AI fluency: you use AI tools daily to compress research cycles, pressure-test messaging, generate content variations, and move from insight to asset faster than a traditional workflow allows

  • Strong cross-functional operating skills, able to align Product, Sales, CS, and Commercial stakeholders around a segment strategy and drive execution

Preferred

  • Experience in cybersecurity, HR tech or a similarly technical B2B environment

  • Experience defining or contributing to solution sets and commercial packaging, not just messaging deliverables.

  • Background in structured pre-launch validation: rep councils, messaging test sessions, early cohort feedback

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, Corporate Discounts, Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!
